title: Checking segments, segment groups and connector groups for a failing application

prose.text: The segment layer is checked from the destination inward: the segment, its group, its server groups and the connectors behind them.

prose.label: Segment.
prose.text: The match rules are in [[zpa.app-segments.matching:granularity-ranking]], Bypass in [[zpa.app-segments.bypass:same-fqdn-always]], Multimatch in [[zpa.app-segments.multimatch]].

prose.label: Segment group.
prose.text: Membership is in [[zpa.segment-groups.membership]] and policy use in [[zpa.segment-groups.policy-use:criterion-checks-segment-or-group]]. {{incomplete-icon}} A segment created without a group is open [[zpa.segment-groups.membership:omitted-segment-group-id]].

prose.label: Server group and connector group.
prose.text: The chain is in [[zpa.app-connectors.connector-groups:segment-server-group-chain]]. That a group with no key or server group serves nothing and is not flagged is not sourced {{gap:group-without-key-or-server-group}}.

checks.do: The exact FQDN and port the user requested against the segments that contain the FQDN, and which one is the most granular.
Whether the destination port is in the winning segment, since a port miss is bypassed or dropped at the client.
Whether a specific-FQDN segment was added for a host the wildcard segment used to cover, which removes the host from the wildcard segment for the ports the specific segment does not list.
Whether any segment for the same FQDN has Bypass set to Always.
That the segment is in a segment group, that it is in only one, and that the group is complete.
That the rule meant to allow the user names the segment or the segment group that holds it.
Which connector groups serve the segment through its server groups, and whether at least one connector in each is connected.
Whether a connector that can reach the cloud reports the targets of the application as alive.

incomplete-icon.statement: On the segment group page, if required fields are missing an Incomplete Configuration icon appears next to the indicated item.

quotes: If there are required fields missing, the Incomplete Configuration icon () appears next to the indicated item.

group-without-key-or-server-group.title: A connector group with no server group or provisioning key
group-without-key-or-server-group.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "Confirm the App Connector group is associated with at least one server group and one provisioning key. A group with neither cannot serve traffic - the console does not flag this partial configuration as invalid." The segment to server group to connector group chain is sourced (segment-server-group-chain); no source says a group lacking either association cannot serve traffic or that the console does not flag it.
